title: First human balloon flight
summary: A hot-air balloon built by the Montgolfier brothers made the first confirmed piloted ascent by humans.
why: The first confirmed human flight; the first free flight followed in Paris on 21 November 1783.

notes.problem: 'First time humans flew' is stronger than 'first confirmed piloted ascent'; place over-broad: tethered flight from the Reveillon workshop, Faubourg Saint-Antoine (Paris).

superlativeSource: launched the first confirmed piloted ascent by humans in 1783
